title: A universally injective etale morphism of algebraic spaces is an open immersion
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma, opening with the slogan 'Universally injective etale maps are open immersions': an etale and universally injective morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S is an open immersion (source lines 10945-10953). The proof reduces to the case of a scheme base by base change stability of the two properties, then observes that the diagonal Delta_{X/Y} is etale, a monomorphism and surjective, hence an isomorphism, so X is separated over Y; by the representability criterion for separated locally quasi-finite morphisms X is then a scheme, and the fundamental theorem for etale morphisms of schemes makes f an open immersion.
